AboutPage.title: About the Project
AboutPage.desc: Swagger/OpenAPI UI is a web application for editing, visualizing, and testing REST APIs based on OpenAPI specifications. It provides an interactive Swagger-like interface with request execution, history tracking, and analytics.

RSS.title: RS School Course
RSS.desc: The Rolling Scopes School is a free, community-based education program conducted by The Rolling Scopes developer community since 2013. This project demonstrates skills acquired during the advanced React path, including full-stack development, routing, testing, and modern UI implementation.
RSS.linkAria: Visit RS School React Course web site
